'''Nesan 22 (November 17)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|998}} - Rand's party arrive at a deserted village. Rand encounters [[Ba'alzamon]] again.
*{{ne|999}} - [[Rand]] returns to [[Caemlyn]], receives a letter from [[Alliandre Maritha Kigarin]], queen of [[Ghealdan]], and is attacked by a [[Gray Man]], who is killed by [[Taim]].
*{{ne|999}} - [[Adeleas]] and [[Vandene]] arrive in [[Salidar]]. [[Thom]] and [[Juilin]] return from [[Amadicia]]. [[Nynaeve]] Heals [[Logain]], [[Siuan]] and [[Leane]]. The Hall reinstates Siuan and Leane as [[Aes Sedai]].
